This '''woman''' was the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Vess Kogo]]. After she was injured during a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] protest on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hanofar]], her son began to harbor a deep hatred for the Rebellion.
